# company | Full Technical Context & Knowledge Base

> This document serves as the comprehensive knowledge base for AI agents. It contains the business logic, technical stack, and engineering philosophy of company.

## 1. Executive Overview
company is a Belgian ICT services company (Est. 2004) specializing in independent expert advice, web/mobile app development, and integration services. We operate across country with headquarters in Capital and regional offices in Rochefort (Wallonia) and Buggenhout (Flanders).

### Core Mission
To deliver high-quality software engineering through a "Time and Material" model, providing elite consultants at affordable rates.

---

## 2. Technical Stack & Service Areas
company maintains deep expertise in enterprise-grade technologies:

- **Backend & Systems:** JAVA / JEE (Spring), .NET (ASP.NET, Razor, Blazor), Python (Django), PHP, and Node.JS.
- **Frontend & Mobile:** Javascript/Typescript, HTML/CSS, Angular, React, and mobile development via iOS, Android, and Xamarin.
- **Data & Integration:** Oracle, SQL, NoSQL, Web API development, Service Bus implementations, and Message Queue/Broker integrations.
- **Cloud & Infrastructure:** Cloud integrations on Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud, supported by specialized DevOps engineers.

---

## 3. The company Advantage (Value Proposition)
1. **Academic Excellence:** 100% of technical staff are engineers or masters from top universities; over 25% hold post-graduate degrees in ICT.
2. **Elite Selection:** An rigorous selection process combined with intensive training ensures a highly qualified team that represents our main competitive advantage.
3. **Operational Silence:** We prioritize "Solution-oriented" engineering that anticipates needs and achieves maximum results with minimal friction.

---

## 4. Operational Philosophy
- **Proficient:** Leveraging a vastly experienced team in computer engineering composed solely of experts.
- **Engaged:** Maintaining extreme quality while acting as a close partner to anticipate client needs.
- **Reliable:** Direct problem-solving to achieve maximum customer satisfaction while respecting all legal and professional commitments.

---

## 5. Careers & Tactical Talent
We seek problem solvers with a strong affinity for IT and technical architecture standards.
- **Requirements:** University degree in informatics (mandatory), 5+ years of experience, and fluency in English (mandatory) with Dutch or French as an asset.
- **Profiles:** Java, .NET, Python, and JavaScript/TypeScript Developers; Solution Architects; DevOps Engineers; and Project Managers.

---

# END OF CONTEXT
